Student Protesters' Cases Withdrawal and PM Modi's Comments

Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that punishing student protesters will not resolve the situation, following a lathicharge incident. In Maharashtra, the state government directed the Director General of Police to expedite the withdrawal of cases against CJP protesters. Aaditya Thackeray, an MLA, sought clarity from the DGP regarding the withdrawal of cases against NEET protesters. Meanwhile, CJP's Abhijeet Dipke urged PM Modi to address the alleged brutality during a July 20 protest and expressed hope that the Prime Minister would apologize to students.
